scope: Completed P3 no-edge runtime/operation implementation with Linux and original ESP32 target lifecycle qualification. Broader Wi-Fi/channel and final deployment gates remain open.
corrections: WAMR linear memory previously escaped the arena through mmap; enabled usage-aware allocation, zeroing linear memory in the charged arena. New budget regression reproduced prior erroneous preparation at 32 KiB.
ESP-IDF malloc can provide only four-byte alignment; arena and allocation headers now guarantee WAMR eight-byte alignment.

Pinned classic interpreter under-aligned x86_64 frame and label stacks. Exact build-copy corrections now align both. The old host binary reproduced this UBSan issue; historical passing CTest status did not demonstrate diagnostic-free UBSan. Current sanitizer builds use -fno-sanitize-recover=undefined.
ESP-IDF monotonic pthread condition attributes are unsupported; retained binary semaphore wakes plus monotonic finite waits replace them on target. Pthread workers preserve WAMR thread identity.

host.sanitizers: ASan, fail-fast UBSan and LSan. WAMR tests retain previously documented fake-stack exception. LSan needed execution outside ptrace sandbox.

python.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/kaos-p3-uv-cache UBSAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1 KAOS_P2_HOST=/tmp/kaos-p3-session/host/core/kaos_p2_host KAOS_P3_HOST=/tmp/kaos-p3-session/host/core/kaos_p3_host KAOS_P3_GUEST=/tmp/kaos-p3-session/host/node.wasm uv --directory ../sim_env run --offline python -m unittest discover -s tests
python.note: Includes nine real UDP/WAMR tests. Sandbox socket-denial run is not counted as passing.

race_check.result: Passed lifecycle cases and 200 concurrent cancellation/disposal cycles without diagnostics. Initial launch failed before main due to memory layout; ASLR-disabled process passed.

formal.result: No errors under documented fairness assumptions.
formal.existing_model: NodeRuntime.tla/.cfg unchanged; prior 496008-state lifecycle check retained, not rerun. No machine-checked composition/refinement proof is claimed.

board.profile: Classic interpreter; same restrictions as host; usage-aware allocator; no guest threads, AOT/JIT, WASI/libc or implicit initialization.

board.bringup: 128 KiB contiguous arenas failed; 96 KiB allowed one node after static admission records were included. Diagnostic preparation measured 82336 arena bytes for the fixture. Final 88 KiB profile passed; temporary debug prints removed before final measurements.

limits: Synthetic local artifact staging on target; host suite covers real UDP/artifact transport. No Wi-Fi traffic in target fixture.
No two-node/one-channel capacity or radio qualification; those remain P4-P9/R05 work.
Observed timing/stack peaks are finite workload measurements, not hard worst-case guarantees.
Whole-node reclamation restores warm baseline; no claim that all one-time ESP-IDF service bookkeeping is reclaimed at shutdown.
Existing NodeRuntime model excludes slot reuse and distinct creator/removal deadlines; concrete tests cover those separately.
Q05 retained-history exception, Q08 authority assumptions and trusted first-main-entry INIT remain unchanged.
Board remains flashed with qualification firmware.
